body.systemName: Double LDPE bag in HDPE drum
body.containerDescription: Double low-density polyethylene bags, each closed with a tie, inside a 25 L high-density polyethylene drum
body.closureDescription: Tamper-evident HDPE lid with a tinned-steel locking ring
body.suitabilityJustification: LDPE in contact with the substance meets Ph. Eur. 3.1.3; no interaction seen in 12 months at 25C/60%RH
